passages.text: Some older pupils return to their primary school to help with an art afternoon. They bring paper leaves to hang from a small display tree near the classroom door. When the door opens, a few leaves fall off because their string loops are too loose. The pupils stop hanging new leaves and check the loops that are already on the tree. They fix the loose ones and invite the younger children to add their drawings. By the end of the afternoon, the display shows work from both groups of pupils.

parallelText.en: Some older pupils return to their primary school to help with an art afternoon.
parallelText.zh: 一些高年级学生回到以前的小学，帮助举办美术活动下午场。

parallelText.en: They bring paper leaves to hang from a small display tree near the classroom door.
parallelText.zh: 他们带来纸叶子，准备挂在教室门边的小展示树上。

parallelText.en: When the door opens, a few leaves fall off because their string loops are too loose.
parallelText.zh: 门打开时，几片叶子掉了下来，因为系绳的圈太松了。

parallelText.en: The pupils stop hanging new leaves and check the loops that are already on the tree.
parallelText.zh: 学生们停止继续挂叶子，先检查已经挂在树上的绳圈。

parallelText.en: They fix the loose ones and invite the younger children to add their drawings.
parallelText.zh: 他们固定好松动的绳圈，然后邀请小朋友添加自己的画。

parallelText.en: By the end of the afternoon, the display shows work from both groups of pupils.
parallelText.zh: 下午结束时，展示树上呈现了两组学生的作品。

wordHelp.meaning: an arrangement for people to look at
curved pieces of string that form circles

passages.text: A group of friends wants to help keep the reading room quiet and tidy. They do not own the room or the books, so they first ask the librarian what help is useful. She suggests returning books to the right places and speaking softly near readers. The friends follow her advice for a week instead of changing things without asking. Their small actions make a difference: readers can find books more easily and work with fewer interruptions. The friends decide to keep helping, with the librarian’s guidance.

parallelText.en: A group of friends wants to help keep the reading room quiet and tidy.
parallelText.zh: 一群朋友想帮助保持阅览室安静、整洁。

parallelText.en: They do not own the room or the books, so they first ask the librarian what help is useful.
parallelText.zh: 房间和书并不属于他们，因此他们先问管理员什么帮助有用。

parallelText.en: She suggests returning books to the right places and speaking softly near readers.
parallelText.zh: 管理员建议把书放回正确位置，并在读者附近轻声说话。

parallelText.en: The friends follow her advice for a week instead of changing things without asking.
parallelText.zh: 朋友们连续一周按建议做，而不是擅自改动东西。

parallelText.en: Their small actions make a difference: readers can find books more easily and work with fewer interruptions.
parallelText.zh: 这些小行动发挥了作用：读者更容易找到书，学习时受到的打扰也少了。

parallelText.en: The friends decide to keep helping, with the librarian’s guidance.
parallelText.zh: 朋友们决定在管理员的指导下继续帮忙。

wordHelp.meaning: things that stop an activity for a while
help and advice about what to do
